prompt: A trail-mix recipe uses peanuts and raisins in the ratio $3 : 2$. To make a batch with $12$ cups of peanuts, how many cups of raisins are needed?
hint: Find the scale factor on peanuts.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Try the same problem with friendlier numbers first — say "20% of 50" — then come back to this one.
Find the scale factor on peanuts.
Peanuts go from $3$ to $12$ — multiplied by $4$. So scale raisins by $4$ too.

explanation: Raisins scale by the same factor: $2 \times 4 = 8$.
